summary.title: CS 61B Spring 2023
summary.one_liner: A course site for UC Berkeley's CS 61B (Spring 2023) listing the weekly schedule of lectures, readings, labs, discussions, projects, homework and exam dates, plus the week 10 announcements.
takeaways: The course covers Java data structures and algorithms week by week, from linked lists and arrays through trees, hashing, graphs, sorting and compression.
Each week lists a reading, a lecture (with video and slides), a discussion or review session, a lab, and any assignments or exams.
Project 2B was due 3/24 with a project party on 3/22, and there was no staff help over spring break (3/25 to 4/2).
Midterm 1 was 2/9 and Midterm 2 was 3/16, both 7-9 PM; the final exam was Tuesday May 9, 8-11 AM.
summary.summary: This is the public course site for CS 61B Spring 2023, the second-semester Java data structures course. The main page shows the Week 10 announcements (survey, Project 2B deadlines and party, spring break policy, and midterm 2 scores) and then a full week-by-week table of 40 lectures with readings, discussion and lab sessions, projects, homework and exams. It is a schedule and course-logistics page rather than a tutorial, so the content is mainly a map of topics covered and due dates.
